positions.name: KestrelwoodRemovalDirective
positions.frame: what should happen to the record of Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration and Quill Ashgrove's involvement in it?
positions.why: src-1 and src-2 are paired imperatives ('Forget' / 'Remove all knowledge') naming the same erasure target with increasing specificity (instrument, frequency, actor); src-3 supplies the factual predicate that licenses the erasure by denying the underlying event ever occurred. Read together, all three describe one directional move: reshaping what the record says about this calibration. The set holds a mild tension in delivery — src-1/src-2 are activated-negative, high-pressure commands, while src-3 is a calm-negative, settled factual claim — but the frame reads that tension as the command-plus-justification structure of a single request, not a contradiction to resolve.
